revisionHistory.basis: independent REV 3 audit byte comparison vs REV 2
SHA-256 comparison of REV 3 vs REV 4 files in this package

revisionHistory.reason: REV5 initial pass read as a generic two-color loading ring (near-concentric ellipses). Rebuilt as one lopsided organic contour (asymmetric bump + pinch, non-elliptical) with the coral run covering most of the shape, an explicit 20deg gap, and a short periwinkle accent (~92deg) continuing from the gap and ending in open space rather than re-tracing a second near-full loop.

cakeConfigurationPresets.note: Presets are composer inputs (recolour and placement). The standalone SVG files keep their default colours. A real app should expose them as props or CSS custom properties.

frostingDecorPairing.method: WCAG relative-luminance contrast and CIE76 dE; thresholds dE<25 WEAK, luminance<1.30 HUE-ONLY are provisional QA heuristics

cakeConfigurationPresets.rule: WEAK pairings (dE76 < 25) must be auto-substituted or blocked with a visible notice. HUE-ONLY pairings (luminance contrast < 1.30) are allowed only where the part carries its own luminance cue (candle highlight stripe, flower inner petals, leaf rib). Provisional QA heuristic, awaiting owner thresholds.

checksumPolicy: Every asset carries one authoritative field, sha256 (full 64-hex digest of the file as delivered in THIS package). previousSha256_<revtag> fields are historical lineage only -- the hash the file had as of that earlier revision -- and are never overwritten. assetRevision/lastChangedIn record the revision tag in which the file's bytes were most recently actually modified; for files unchanged since baseline this is 'rev0' or 'rev4' as already recorded, not invented.
pathPolicy: relativePath is the filesystem path from the package/repo root: public/assets/svg/<family>/<file>. publicUrl is the Next.js-served URL for the same file (the public/ prefix is stripped by Next.js static serving): /assets/svg/<family>/<file>.
